lines.text: Gentiles who did not pursue righteousness obtained one by faith, but Israel stumbled over the stone laid in Zion.
Paul prays for Israel's salvation, saying they are zealous for God but ignorant, and that Abraham is the end of the law.
Moses writes that the man who does these things will live by them, while the word of faith is near you.
If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your eyes that God raised Him, you will be saved.
Faith comes by hearing the word of Christ, and God says He held out His hands all day to a disobedient people.
